headlines.title: 吴清：正抓紧推进人民币股票交易柜台、REITs纳入沪深港通各项准备工作
headlines.summary: 中国证监会主席吴清8月3日在香港交易所举行的五年期中国国债期货上市仪式上表示，当前中国证监会会同香港方面正在抓紧推进人民币股票交易柜台、REITs纳入沪深港通各项准备工作，相信这座大桥将会越来越宽敞，越来越稳固，越来越通畅。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: Wu Qing: Preparations are being accelerated to include RMB stock trading counters and REITs in the Stock Connect schemes
headlines.summary_en: Wu Qing, Chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), said at the listing ceremony for the five-year China government bond futures held at the Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing (HKEX) on August 3 that the CSRC, together with the Hong Kong side, is currently accelerating preparations for including RMB stock trading counters and REITs in the Shanghai-Hong Kong and Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect programs. He expressed confidence that this bridge will become increasingly broad, stable, and smooth. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: 中国证监会与香港证监会联合公布深化两地市场务实合作与密切协同发展的新举措
headlines.summary: 中国证监会与香港证监会联合公布一系列进一步深化两地市场务实合作、密切协同发展的新举措。涵盖上市融资、指数合作、期货产品、交易所买卖基金（ETF）、金融机构国际化、绿色金融及专业资格便利化等多个范畴，具体举措包括：继续支持符合条件的境内企业赴港上市融资；支持两地指数公司加强合作，推出更多基于中国资产的指数，提升中国指数和中国资产国际影响力；深化两地期货市场合作，支持香港推出更多人民币计价结算的期货品种；支持两地机构推出更多基于两地市场、布局中国现代化产业体系的ETF产品，对常规股票ETF产品实施快速注册机制等等。

headlines.title_en: China's CSRC and Hong Kong SFC jointly announce new measures to deepen practical cooperation and close coordinated development between the two markets
headlines.summary_en: China's CSRC and Hong Kong's SFC jointly announced a series of new measures to further deepen practical cooperation and close coordinated development between the two markets. The measures span multiple areas including listing and financing, index collaboration, futures products, exchange-traded funds (ETFs), financial institution internationalization, green finance, and professional qualification facilitation. Specific measures include: continuing to support eligible mainland enterprises to list and raise funds in Hong Kong; supporting closer cooperation between index companies of the two places to launch more indices based on Chinese assets and enhance the international influence of Chinese indices and assets; deepening futures market cooperation between the two places and supporting Hong Kong in launching more RMB-denominated and settled futures products; supporting institutions from both places in launching more ETF products based on the two markets and aligned with China's modern industrial system, and implementing a fast-track registration mechanism for conventional stock ETFs.

headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China (PBOC) conducted 63 billion yuan of 7-day reverse repurchase agreements in open market operations at an operation rate of 1.40%, unchanged from the previous level. At the same time, it conducted 300 billion yuan of overnight reverse repos. A total of 925.5 billion yuan of reverse repos matured today.

headlines.title: 吴清：积极支持符合条件的内地企业在香港上市
headlines.summary: 在香港交易所举行的五年期中国国债期货上市仪式上，中国证监会主席吴清表示，将把支持香港国际金融中心建设摆在突出位置。在支持企业赴港上市方面，大力优化境外上市备案工作流程，提升规范化和透明度，积极支持符合条件的内地企业在香港上市。

headlines.title_en: Wu Qing: Actively support eligible mainland enterprises to list in Hong Kong
headlines.summary_en: At the listing ceremony for the five-year China government bond futures held at the Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing, Wu Qing, Chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), said that supporting the development of Hong Kong as an international financial center will be given a prominent position. Regarding support for enterprises to list in Hong Kong, efforts will be made to vigorously optimize the filing procedures for overseas listings, enhance standardization and transparency, and actively support eligible mainland enterprises in listing in Hong Kong.

headlines.title: 香港证监会主席黄天祐：港交所国债期货是离岸产品的重大突破
headlines.summary: 8月3日，在香港交易所举办的中国国债期货上市仪式上，香港证监会主席黄天祐表示，作为目前唯一在离岸市场上市的中国国债期货，这一创举意义深远：一方面，它为全球投资者提供了对冲在岸利率风险的有效工具，助力资产配置的持续优化；另一方面，它能有效提升国债市场的参与度、流动性及定价效率，进一步促进内地与海外市场之间的双向资本流动。因此，国债期货不仅是离岸产品的重大突破，更是内地金融市场推进高水平对外开放、深化人民币国际化进程中，一座举足轻重的里程碑。

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong SFC Chairman Wong Tin-yau: HKEX treasury bond futures mark a major breakthrough for offshore products
headlines.summary_en: On August 3, at the China government bond futures listing ceremony held at the Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing, Huang Tianyou, Chairman of the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission (SFC), stated that as the only Chinese government bond futures currently listed on the offshore market, this initiative is of profound significance: on the one hand, it provides global investors with an effective tool to hedge onshore interest rate risks, facilitating the continued optimization of asset allocation; on the other hand, it can effectively enhance market participation, liquidity, and pricing efficiency in the government bond market, further promoting two-way capital flows between the mainland and overseas markets. Therefore, treasury bond futures are not only a major breakthrough in offshore products, but also a pivotal milestone in advancing the high-level opening-up of mainland financial markets and deepening the internationalization of the RMB.

headlines.title: 吴清：研究扩大两地证券期货专业人员资格互认范围
headlines.summary: 中国证监会主席吴清在香港推出人民币国债期货上市仪式上的致辞中表示，香港一直是内地金融机构走向世界的“桥头堡”。我们将支持更多优质证券基金公司在港展业兴业、走向世界，建设一流投资银行和投资机构，为中国企业和投资者全球化布局提供更加高效适配的金融服务。研究扩大两地证券期货专业人员资格互认范围，便利优秀专业人才两地就业执业。我们将和香港监管部门进一步加强监管协作，深化发行上市、中介机构、监管执法等领域合作，同时不断完善风险监测和信息共享机制，加强资本跨境流动风险监测和协同应对，防范系统性风险。（证监会）

headlines.title_en: Wu Qing: Study to expand the scope of mutual recognition of professional qualifications for securities and futures practitioners between the two regions
headlines.summary_en: In his speech at the listing ceremony for RMB government bond futures launched in Hong Kong, Wu Qing, Chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), stated that Hong Kong has always served as the "bridgehead" for mainland financial institutions going global. We will support more high-quality securities and fund companies in conducting business and expanding in Hong Kong to go global, building first-class investment banks and investment institutions, and providing more efficient and well-adapted financial services for the global expansion of Chinese enterprises and investors. We will study expanding the scope of mutual recognition of professional qualifications for securities and futures professionals between the two places, facilitating excellent professionals in pursuing careers and practicing in both locations. We will further strengthen regulatory cooperation with Hong Kong regulatory authorities, deepen collaboration in areas such as listing and issuance, intermediaries, and regulatory enforcement, while continuously improving risk monitoring and information-sharing mechanisms, strengthening monitoring and coordinated response to cross-border capital flow risks, and preventing systemic risks. (CSRC)

headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.summary_zh: 最新报告显示，尽管政府持续借贷，但家庭和企业因房价下跌、收入增长乏力及利润空间收窄而减少借贷，中国第二季度债务与国内生产总值之比自2022年以来首次下降。该比率下降1.1个百分点，至308.2%。

headlines.title: 香港证监会黄天祐：新举措助力两地资本市场更高水平互联互通
headlines.summary: 【香港证监会黄天祐：新举措助力两地资本市场更高水平互联互通】8月3日，在香港交易所举行的五年期中国国债期货上市仪式上，香港证监会主席黄天祐表示，一系列新举措聚焦众多核心领域，包括上市融资、产品创新、绿色金融、金融机构“走出去”及专业资格便利化等，勾划出两地资本市场迈向更高水平互联互通的清晰路径，也为未来的协同发展注入强劲动能。

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong SFC's Wong Tin-yau: New measures help achieve higher-level connectivity between the two capital markets
headlines.summary_en: [Hong Kong SFC Huang Tianyou: New measures to promote higher-level connectivity between the two capital markets] On August 3, at the listing ceremony for the five-year China government bond futures held at the Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing, Huang Tianyou, Chairman of the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission (SFC), stated that the series of new measures focuses on numerous core areas, including listing and financing, product innovation, green finance, financial institutions' "going global," and professional qualification facilitation, outlining a clear path for the two capital markets to achieve higher-level connectivity and injecting strong momentum for future coordinated development.

headlines.title: 吴清：内地企业占港股市值八成 成交额九成 香港金融发展成效突出 证监会将持续落实惠港政策 多领域深化合作
headlines.summary: 中国证监会与香港证监会联合公布一系列进一步深化两地市场务实合作、密切协同发展的新举措。涵盖上市融资、指数合作、期货产品、交易所买卖基金（ETF）、金融机构国际化、绿色金融及专业资格便利化等多个范畴，具体举措包括：继续支持符合条件的境内企业赴港上市融资；支持两地指数公司加强合作，推出更多基于中国资产的指数，提升中国指数和中国资产国际影响力；深化两地期货市场合作，支持香港推出更多人民币计价结算的期货品种；支持两地机构推出更多基于两地市场、布局中国现代化产业体系的ETF产品，对常规股票ETF产品实施快速注册机制等等。

headlines.title: 7月RatingDog中国制造业PMl录得50.9 连续第八个月处于扩张区间
headlines.summary: 7月RatingDog中国制造业PMl录得50.9，较6月回落0.8个百分点，连续第八个月处于扩张区间，且为五年来并列最长扩张周期。整体来看，7月制造业扩张态势延续，但速度有所放缓。新订单持续增长，成本压力进一步缓解，新出口订单重返扩张释放了积极信号。但采购活动有所减少，且企业前期积累的投入品库存持续上升，是后续需要关注的风险点。（RatingDog）

headlines.title_en: July RatingDog China Manufacturing PMI at 50.9, marks eighth consecutive month in expansion territory
headlines.summary_en: July RatingDog China Manufacturing PMI recorded 50.9, down 0.8 percentage points from June, remaining in the expansion zone for the eighth consecutive month, and marking the longest expansion cycle tied in five years. Overall, the manufacturing sector continued to expand in July, but at a slower pace. New orders continued to grow, cost pressures further eased, and new export orders returning to expansion sent a positive signal. However, purchasing activities decreased, and the rising inventory of inputs accumulated by enterprises in earlier periods is a risk point that warrants attention going forward. (RatingDog)
